{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out refunded orders (only completed orders are relevant for conversion rate)
completed_only = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rate = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rate.max()

print(f'Conversion rates by segment: \n{conversion_rate}')
print(f'Best segment: {best_segment} with rate {best_rate:.4f}')"}
